mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.api, a.url, a.param, a.result, a.error, DATE_FORMAT(a.createtime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createtime, DATE_FORMAT(a.maintaintime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as maintaintime, a.status, a.delflag, a.retrycount, DATE_FORMAT(a.lastretrytime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastretrytime, DATE_FORMAT(a.successtime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as successtime, a.finalfailflag FROM sync_erp_iqc_fail_log a ORDER BY a.id desc
and a.api like concat('%',#{api}, '%')
and a.maintaintime >= concat(#{maintaintimefrom}, ' 00:00:00')
and a.maintaintime <= concat(#{maintaintimeto}, ' 23:59:59')
and a.status = #{status}
